_doc: SAMPLE for tools\setup\Invoke-PimTenantPrep.ps1. Copy to tenant-prep.custom.json (gitignored) and put your real values there -- never in this file. Every id below is FAKE. identity: EITHER clientId + certThumbprint (certificate in LocalMachine\My) OR keyVault + clientIdSecret + certThumbprintSecret (secret NAMES, read at run time with Get-AzKeyVaultSecret). privateStore: false = close the build window with Close-PimSqlSetupHostRule.ps1, true = Set-PimSqlBuildWindow.ps1 -Mode Close. prereqs[].options: EnableSentinel, GrantAzureUserAccessAdministrator, SkipDataOperations (true/false), ConfirmPortalStep [check ids], SentinelWorkspaceId, AzureScope [scopes]. templates: pack ids (templates\<id>.template.json) or all-active.
